items.title: Ink Droplets In Motion Snag Top Prize In Nikon Small World Contest
items.summary: A 25-year-old German photographer won the 2026 Nikon Small World competition with a microscopic image freezing ink droplets in midair as an inkjet printer deposits them onto paper.

items.title: Qualys CISO on what security teams can do as exploit campaigns grow
items.summary: In this Help Net Security interview, Nathan Smolenski, CISO at Qualys, talks about how security teams can handle the growing volume of AI-discovered vulnerabilities.

items.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited VMware ESX Zero-Day to Reduce Audit Trail Visibility
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added a security flaw impacting Broadcom VMware ESX to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, after CrowdStrike revealed that it had been weaponized by a China-nexus threat actor known as Warp Panda in attacks targeting the U.S.

items.title: Deploying a Local Ghidra Server for Your Malware Analysis Lab, (Thu, Oct 29th)
items.summary: Building your malware analysis lab is a key point before playing with malware. Today, thanks to virtualization, it&#;x26;#;39;s convenient to play with snapshots in your lab. Start a new investigation from a clean snapshot and take some more when you reached a critical step.

items.title: IT bosses are confident they’ve found the certificates they don’t know about
items.summary: Forty percent of 500 senior IT and security leaders surveyed for certificate authority Sectigo said they are very prepared for monthly TLS certificate renewals because automated systems are already in place. Their more specific answers point elsewhere.

items.title: Attackers Exploit PHP2Shell Flaws in Internet-Exposed Palo Alto Networks Management Interfaces
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks on Wednesday warned that threat actors are exploiting the recently patched PHP2Shell vulnerabilities against publicly-accessible management interfaces.

items.title: Shame and sleepless nights haunt scam victims long after the money is gone
items.summary: Scams and identity theft hurt people in different ways, and recovering involves much more than getting money back, according to ITRC’s 2026 Consumer Impact Report. Scam victims often struggle with shame and self-blame, while identity theft victims can spend weeks of personal effort trying to repair the damage.

items.title: Stolen staff logins are spreading attacks between K-12 school districts
items.summary: Last school year, 808 K-12 school organizations got some unwelcome news. The Multi-State Information Sharing and Analysis Center (MS-ISAC) told them their staff accounts or credentials were circulating on underground and dark web marketplaces.

items.title: CVE-2026-42922: A authorization bypass vulnerability exists in the /nodered functionality of FUXA (version(s): 1.3.2-2809).
